name: AP_CLAIM_4
description: The AP_CLAIM_4 table contains one record for each claim in the managed care system's AP Claims module.

columns.name: CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the claim record.

columns.name: TOT_ADDL_ADJ
columns.description: Stores the total additional adjustments for the claim.

columns.name: AP_CLAIM_IMPORT_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: Used to define the type of source a claim is imported from to drive reporting on the different use cases a single workflow type may have.

columns.name: SOURCE_GROUP_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: SERVICE_DATE_FROM_LINE_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether the service date was received at the header level, or was determined based on service lines.

columns.name: NCH_CLAIM_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The National Claims History (NCH) code indicating the type of claim submitted.
entries: Non swing bed Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) claim
Swing bed Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) claim
Local carrier non-durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, and supplies (DMEPOS) claim
Local carrier durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, and supplies (DMEPOS) claim
Durable medical equipment regional carrier (DMERC); non-DMEPOS claim
Durable medical equipment regional carrier (DMERC); DMEPOS claim

columns.name: PAID_CLM_FILE_INTEREST_AMT
columns.description: The total interest amount from the file for an externally paid claim.

columns.name: PAID_CLM_FILE_PENALTY_AMT
columns.description: The total penalty amount from the file for an externally paid claim.
